If n has potency in respect r, the unchanged act-priority reading gives y simply prior to n. Firstness forces y=n; irreflexivity then contradicts this self-priority. Seven inputs replace only STMT-NOTHING-IN-ACT-AND-POTENCY-IN-SAME-RESPECT by STMT-STRICT-SIMPLE-PRIORITY; the other six are unchanged. No transitivity, global well-foundedness, finite ancestry, positive actuality, uniqueness, maximum or God naming is used. This is a conditional alternative configuration, not a premise discharge, global weakening or minimality claim. No source reading or reality correspondence is newly established. Second keep strict component priority and old potency but stipulate act in every respect: irreflexivity and act-priority hold, while exclusivity fails at instrument/drive. The distinct-priority-to-actual-ground bridge is checked for both assignments; its distinctness guard excludes the added self-loop. Population, whole-roster non-trapping and contingent-ground coverage reuse the exact old profile. Contingent coverage is vacuous in its all-present ontology. Thus neither replacement condition implies the other even with the remaining six interfaces. Fixed dictionary within each comparison; no claim that the two assignments have identical primitive valuations. These formal joint configurations are not metaphysical possibility, an adequate explanation, independent truth of either condition or a global route minimality claim.
